sentences.text:
Author: Joymalya Bagchi
Bench: Joymalya Bagchi
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
03.10.2024
 21
 sdas
 C.R.R. No. 3536 of 2024
 In Re : Aroshikha Mistry & Anr. .....petitioners
 Mr. Pawan Kumar Gupta
 Ms. Safia Nesar
 Mr. Santanu Sett
 Mr. Abhijit Bose
 ....... for the petitioners
 1.
Petitioners are in-laws of the opposite party no.
2/wife.
They submit petitioner no. 1 is residing at Bangalore and petitioner no. 2 is working in Mumbai.
Hardly any allegation of cruelty is levelled against them in the impugned charge-sheet.
2. In view of the aforesaid submission, I am of the opinion possibility of malicious institution of the proceeding against the petitioners owing to a matrimonial dispute cannot be ruled out.
Petitioners have made out an arguable case for quashing.

3. Copy of the petition be served upon opposite party no. 1/State through learned Public Prosecutor,
High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no. 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit-of-service be filed on the next date of hearing.
4. Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" four weeks after Puja Vacation.
CRR/3536/2024 on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146803122/
1 5.

There shall be stay of operation of the proceedings in connection with G.R. Case No. 238 of 2024 arising out of Sonarpur Police Station Case No. 33 of 2024 dated 08.01.2024 under Sections 498A/325/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act pending before the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Baruipur, District- South 24 Paragans for a period of six weeks after Puja Vacation or until further orders whichever is earlier.
